$comment: Generated by pnpm features:sync from packages/features/src/registry.ts. Only config.deployment and config.features are constrained.

deployment.description: Which product this install is. Only OpenWork Cloud sets "cloud". Renders DEN_DEPLOYMENT.

whiteLabel.description: White-label appearance: Customize organization app names, logos, icons, and colors. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WHITE_LABEL.

teamMembershipCache.description: Team membership cache: Reduce repeated team lookups while keeping access changes immediate. Enable only after every API instance runs revision-aware team writes. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TEAM_MEMBERSHIP_CACHE.

managedDeploymentsGcp.description: GCP managed deployments: Organization admins approve OpenWork installations in their own Google Cloud project and track health and updates. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS_GCP.

managedDeployments.description: Managed deployments: Organization admins install OpenWork in their own cloud account (AWS first) and see its health and updates in OpenWork. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS.

slackAssistant.description: Slack Assistant: Answers Slack mentions and DMs for the organization after the Slack connector is set up. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_ASSISTANT.

slackWorkbotReplies.description: Slack: replies like Workbot: OpenWork in Slack writes its reply as it works, reacts to messages with an emoji, and takes bigger jobs into the background, posting the result in the thread when done. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_WORKBOT_REPLIES.

workbot.description: Workbot: Members can use Workbot, with side chats, a Calendar tab of its scheduled work and the option to run stopped tasks again, and organization admins choose the default model Workbot, the Slack assistant and cloud Automations answer with. Needs the deployment's Workbot app. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT.

automationCalendar.description: Calendar: desktop app: Members see a Calendar in the desktop app with their Automations next to meetings from their connected Google or Outlook calendar. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTOMATION_CALENDAR.

permissions.description: Permissions: Organization admins choose what members, admins and each team can do, instead of the fixed Member and Admin defaults. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PERMISSIONS.

teamRoles.description: Team roles: Members › Teams shows each team's role (Member, Admin or Custom) with one Change role action, and Members gets a Roles tab to see and create roles. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TEAM_ROLES.

sharedRoles.description: Shared roles: A custom role can be given to more than one team: Change role lists every role, each role's page lists its teams, and a role can be created before any team has it. Needs Team roles and Permissions. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SHARED_ROLES.

agentPermissions.description: Agent permissions: Organization admins choose what agents can do on members' computers: run commands, edit files, open websites and use local skills and MCP servers, for everyone or per team. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AGENT_PERMISSIONS.

engineV2Upgrade.description: Desktop: upgrade prompt to OpenCode v2: Desktop members still on OpenCode v1 see a short notice offering to upgrade: their chats are copied to v2 with a backup, then OpenWork switches engines. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ENGINE_V2_UPGRADE.

remoteSessionEvents.description: Remote session events: MCP clients can subscribe to changes in their remote session receipts and read the current state after reconnecting. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_EVENTS.

backgroundShellTasks.description: Desktop: running background tasks in chat: The desktop chat shows how many commands the agent left running in the background, and adds a short row when each one finishes. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BACKGROUND_SHELL_TASKS.

orgDefaultModel.description: Desktop: organization default model: Organization admins choose the model new desktop chats start with, for everyone or per team. Applies to the OpenCode v2 engine only; members can still change the model in each chat. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ORG_DEFAULT_MODEL.
